title: Which country will announce a new multinational maritime coalition to protect navigation through the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Gulf of Aden by August 1, 2026?
background: Attacks on commercial shipping since 2023 have heightened concerns about the security of maritime trade routes through the Red Sea.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official government announcements or contemporaneous reporting by reputable international news organizations. 
  Resolution Conditions : Identify the country that announces the creation of a new multinational maritime coalition between July 1 and August 1, 2026, inclusive, with a stated purpose of protecting freedom of navigation through the Red Sea, Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Gulf of Aden. Joining an existing coalition does not qualify. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.
